text:
Asha: Uploaded 'midnight-ink' theme draft in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/midnight-ink. Goal: deeper base (#040507), neutral panels (#0A0B0C), and a restrained accent that still reads in tiny UI. Looking for quick checks on legends, micro-badges, and code blocks.
Tom: Legend labels on stacked charts are cramped. When there are 6 items the colored swatches are hard to tell apart at 12px. Maybe increase swatch size or allow hover to highlight series.
Rina: Hover-to-highlight is good. Also propose accessible legend mode: list view with text and contrast-friendly markers for screen-reader users.
Carlos: Micro-badges (8px counter) fail 3:1 contrast on this base. Either bump to 10px min or add a subtle inner shadow/backdrop.
Marta: For inline code, current pale cyan is lost on low-dpi. Can we try border-left accent instead of filled token? Example: `.inline-code { border-left:2px solid var(--accent); padding-left:6px }` preserves context and improves legibility.
Asha: Noted on badges & inline-code. Will prototype border-left. For legend swatches I prefer bumping size to 14px and enabling hover highlight; stacked tooltip can show full label list on click.
Tom: Also see hover vs selection ambiguity: our hover tint and selected state are same hue, different opacity. Users reported confusion. Suggest selection use a distinct outline or warmer tint so hover doesn't look permanent.
Rina: Agreed. Selection = outline + subtle glow; hover = low-opacity fill. Keyboard focus needs a visible 3:1 contrast ring too.
Carlos: Color-blindness: the accent ramp (blue->teal) still causes confusion for adjacent bars. Consider keeping hue similar but increasing lightness deltas (Lab L*) across steps.
Marta: Small copy nit: tooltips say "units" in two places and "tokens" elsewhere. Standardize to "tokens" and update localization keys.
Asha: Will update copy. Quick CSS snippet I'll try for focus ring: `.row:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(99,164,255,0.95); outline-offset:4px }`
Tom: For tiny sparklines, add a 1px outer stroke that uses panel-contrast color to keep visibility at 1x displays.
Rina: Add a per-user "Chart contrast" toggle in settings (remember per-user). Enterprise users love that.
Theme-Bot: Design review created: DR-4420 - "Midnight-ink: legends, badges, focus & chart contrast" assigned to @Asha. Comments due in 48h.
Asha: Thanks team 44D I'll post updated tokens + a minimal changelog later today.
